p: Wyke is a residential village on the southern edge of Bradford, close to Low Moor and handy for the M606. Hanover Square is the little local hub, so this is the kind of place locals pop into on the way past rather than somewhere people travel across the city for.

If you're making a proper day of it in Bradford, the city centre is a short drive or bus ride north. The National Science and Media Museum is free to get into, City Park with its big mirror pool is great for the kids in summer, and Bradford's curry houses are famous for good reason.
Just remember the gaming side here is for over-18s only.
